subject: pe
title: Anatomy: Skeleton
welcome_lead: Your skeleton is the frame, the shield and the levers of movement.
meta_desc: KS3 PE: bones, skeleton roles, key bones.
final_note: About 206 bones — and they work as a team.

concepts.def: All the bones in your body together.
Hard living tissue forming the skeleton.

walkthroughs.body_html: The skeleton gives support (you don't flop), protection (skull guards brain), movement (muscles pull bones) and makes blood cells inside bones.
An adult has about 206 bones. Babies have more — some fuse as they grow.
Where two bones meet is a joint. Knees and elbows hinge; shoulders and hips swivel. Cartilage and fluid stop them scraping.
